opening.argument: The offer promises an unusually high-value reward with no apparent barrier: “How to get a FREE $1000 VICTORIA S SECRET GIFT CARD.” It then directs viewers to an external website to claim it, while the visual advertisement repeats both the branded gift-card offer and the destination. A later card adds “HURRY UP!” and again instructs viewers to visit and claim the same reward, reinforcing urgency around the external visit. The material does not establish the website’s ownership or authorization, eligibility conditions, data or payment requests, fulfillment, or any completed transaction, but those unknowns do not cure the prominent low-barrier promise and claim direction.
